description:
Play Khalni Garden.
Khalni Garden enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama, Cloudstone Curio, and itself.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Dwarven Mine from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dwarven Mine enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Khalni Garden from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dwarven Mine trigger, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
The Dwarf enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Khalni Garden from your hand onto the battlefield.
Khalni Garden enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Dwarven Mine from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Khalni Garden trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
The Plant enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama and Cloudstone Curio.
Repeat from step 3.
